cards.condition: recorded selection or hold/reject decision before capture extension
core p1 acceptance; fast/slow and capture extensions need separate selection and acceptance
preparation acceptance only; collection and analysis are deferred to separately authorized future work
conditional design without claiming actual participant results or demonstrated UX improvement

gates.condition: future collection acceptance only; not required to finish the current preparation package
future result-based design acceptance; not a claim supported by preparation-only work
readiness package only; no participant recruitment, collection, translation execution or contact

conditional decision package only when actual research results are unavailable
Owned helper API frozen, independently reviewed and handed off before serialized INTEGRATION edits; this is not CRW-02 card acceptance.

Separately versioned execution-reference contract and canonical vectors independently reviewed. Preserve all accepted v1 bytes. Verified own roots are explicit collection/id pairs; null pairs remain unknown. Effect authority remains crew_runs only.
Context receipt projection, pure decision API and fixtures independently reviewed before serialized meeting/store INTEGRATION handoff. Not full CRW-03 card acceptance.

handoff_rules: One file has one writer at a time, including tests and contracts.
A consumer never edits a producer-owned shared type; send the change to its named owner.
INTEGRATION edits shared product files only after the card contract and current source are reviewed.
Substage acceptance is not full-card or product acceptance. Conditional substages require a recorded selection or hold/reject decision.
Private roots require an absolute binding in a private dispatch record before work. Public files do not contain those bindings.
The fixed v1 contract is immutable. A publication conflict never permits redaction or a new hash under the same contract ID.
Existing Claude work and release/build paths are not owned by this plan.
Root may delegate disjoint INTEGRATION file sets after accepted contracts. Every actual path retains exactly one active writer; crossing a dispatch boundary requires a fresh handoff.

private_root_rules: Bindings must be absolute ordinary directories and must not overlap one another or the repository root.
A private root alias cannot be rebound while a task holds files under it.
writer_rules: Resolve root aliases before checking physical path overlap.
One active assignment per owned file, including shared files and tests.
Existing Claude work is outside the assignment even when a relative filename matches.
